headline: Northbridge Athletic Wins 2-1 Over Riverton City
summary: Northbridge Athletic secured a 2-1 victory against Riverton City with goals from Nico Vantreight and Luca Ferrandi. Riverton's Marcus Delacroix-Hunt scored an equalizer early in the second half. Northbridge had a goal disallowed and Riverton's Gabriel Ndiaye-Shaw was sent off after a second yellow card. Both teams created numerous chances, with Riverton taking more shots but Northbridge converting a late penalty to clinch the win.

turning_points.text: Nico Vantreight opened the scoring for Northbridge Athletic.
Gabriel Ndiaye-Shaw received a second yellow card, reducing Riverton to ten men.
Luca Ferrandi scored a penalty to give Northbridge the winning goal.

stories.claim: #2 D. Mensah-Lowe ran 36.5 m in 5.5 s from 26.2 m behind to 4.4 m ahead on the right flank, received a pass, and delivered a cross 2.8 s later.
